_about: Lore pages, found in hidden encampments. Each act has its pages, handed out in order; collected pages assemble the hidden story (art/WORLD.md, section 7).

pages.title: A survey note, very old paper
pages.text: Site confirmed. The structure predates the city above it by a margin we cannot measure. Every floor carries the same mark: a square with a line through it, like a door seen edge-on.

pages.title: A contractor's warning sign
pages.text: DO NOT REMOVE SEALS. Orange, conical, standard issue. The contractor laughed when we ordered ten thousand traffic cones. He stopped laughing when we told him where they were going.

pages.title: A child's drawing
pages.text: Crayon: a tall building going down instead of up. Eighteen floors. At the bottom, a big face with no eyes. Written underneath, carefully: THE BUILDING WAS HERE FIRST.

pages.title: A torn page of a site diary
pages.text: Day 41. The knocking under Floor 1 counts in sevens. The foreman says it's pipes. There are no pipes. We stacked more cones and it stopped.

pages.title: A laminated safety card
pages.text: IF YOU HEAR YOUR NAME FROM BELOW: do not answer. Do not count along. Do not open any door marked with the symbol. Report to your floor warden. (There are no floor wardens. Not any more.)

pages.title: Scratched into a stair rail
pages.text: We were the first season. There was no show yet. Just us, and the stairs, and the counting.

pages.title: A season pass, Season 3
pages.text: ADMIT ONE CONTESTANT. VALID FOR ALL FLOORS. NON-REFUNDABLE. NON-TRANSFERABLE. NON-RETURNABLE. The holder's photo is a woman who looks a lot like Marta, only forty years younger.

pages.title: A fan letter
pages.text: Dear Contestant 0412, you are my favourite. I watch you every night. I have watched you for nine years. Please never reach the bottom, because then the show will end.

pages.title: A wristband log
pages.text: Fans: 1,204,881. Fans: 1,207,330. Fans: 0. Fans: 0. Fans: 0. The last entry is dated the day the wearer reached Floor 9.

pages.title: A production memo
pages.text: Re: winners. Under no circumstances is a winner to be shown leaving. The audience must believe there is an exit. Wardrobe will handle the rest.

pages.title: A season-wrap photo
pages.text: Forty contestants smiling on the stairs. On the back, in pen, a tick beside every name but one. The one has been scratched out so hard the paper tore.

pages.title: A suggestion-box card
pages.text: Could we please have a floor that isn't trying to kill us? Signed, everyone. The reply, stamped in red: NOTED. RATINGS DISAGREE.

pages.title: A Builders' tablet, translated
pages.text: We did not build a prison for monsters. We built a stomach for appetites, and sealed it, so that it would digest them slowly and the world above could forget it was ever hungry.

pages.title: A priest's confession
pages.text: Saint Tally doesn't want the debt paid. She wants the counting. If every debt were paid there would be nothing left to count, and she would starve.

pages.title: A flooded hymn book
pages.text: Old Damp only wants what anyone wants: to be remembered. That is why the water rises. Everything left behind floats up eventually.

pages.title: A Builders' maintenance schedule
pages.text: Seal check, Floors 1-18. Appetites quiet. Then, in a different hand, years later: SIGNAL DETECTED. SOMEONE IS FEEDING THEM. SOMEONE IS WATCHING.

pages.title: Mags' notebook
pages.text: Gods are just hungers with good PR. I picked none. Forty years and I've never been better rested.

pages.title: A rat's ballot
pages.text: Vote for the Good Neighbour: everyone the same, everyone home. The rats tick the box every year. They never ask what home means.

pages.title: A rating sheet
pages.text: Fan count is not popularity. It is load. Each viewer's attention is metered, converted and routed down. Contestants are the wick. Fans are the flame.

pages.title: A stagehand's notebook
pages.text: We don't film them. We point the cameras so the audience looks, and the looking does the rest. I quit after I worked out where the looking goes.

pages.title: A script page, Season 9
pages.text: SCENE 4. CONTESTANT DIES. (Hold the shot. Let them watch. Big spike. Remember what the spike is for.)

pages.title: An agent's contract
pages.text: Clause 12: the talent agrees that their likeness, voice, fans and soul are licensed to the Network in perpetuity, throughout the universe, in all media now known or hereafter devised.

pages.title: Dex's diary
pages.text: Two million fans. I can feel them now. Like a hand on my back, pushing. Downwards.

pages.title: A canteen menu
pages.text: Today's special: whatever was left over from yesterday's contestants. (A joke, the chef says. Probably.)

pages.title: The Builders' last entry
pages.text: The signal found the seals. It feeds them, and they feed it, and the people on the stairs pay for both. We are turning off the lights. Someone else will have to turn off the rest.

pages.title: A museum label
pages.text: SEASON 9: CASTLE DREAD. Cast retained on site for authenticity. Please do not feed the cast.

pages.title: The first contestant's wristband
pages.text: Contestant 0001. Fans: 1. The one fan's ID matches the Network's founding account.

pages.title: A backup tape label
pages.text: EVERYONE. ALL SEASONS. DO NOT ERASE. DO NOT PLAY BACK. Someone has stuck a gold star on it.

pages.title: A card from the Index
pages.text: FILED UNDER: YOU. See also: everyone who came before you. See also: everyone who will.

pages.title: Rattle's memory, recovered
pages.text: My name was Ruth. Season 4. I reached Floor 15 and they offered me a job. I didn't know the job was being a guard forever.

pages.title: A school report card
pages.text: A natural performer. Charming. Must learn that not everyone in the room is his audience. Grade: A+. Teacher's note, later: he never left the room.

pages.title: A winner's certificate
pages.text: SEASON 1 CHAMPION. Prize: the show. All of it. Forever. Congratulations.

pages.title: A letter to his mother
pages.text: Mum, I won. They say I have to stay and host now. Just for a while. I'll be home for dinner.

pages.title: A director's note
pages.text: Every winner becomes the next Host. The old Host becomes the set. Please do not tell the talent.

pages.title: A switch label
pages.text: MASTER BROADCAST. ON / OFF. There has never been a reason to use OFF. There has never been anyone allowed this far down.

pages.title: Unsigned, on the Builders' seat
pages.text: If you are reading this, you got here. That means you can choose. We couldn't. Choose better.
